pokemon_scp.name: Zubat
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0041 is to be contained in a low‑light aviary chamber with ultrasonic dampeners. Personnel must wear auditory protection during interaction. All ventilation shafts must be sealed with mesh rated for corrosive saliva.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0041 is a small bat‑like organism lacking ocular structures. It navigates via ultrasonic pulses capable of disrupting electronic sensors. Saliva samples show mild corrosive properties.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: SCP-0041 is skittish and avoids bright light. Displays swarm‑like behavior when multiple instances are present.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0041-A: SCP-0041’s ultrasonic pulses disabled a drone mid‑flight.
Addendum 0041-B: Corrosive saliva dissolved a containment latch within hours.

pokemon_scp.name: Golbat
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0042 is to be contained in a reinforced aerial vault with blood‑filtration systems. Personnel must not enter without full protective gear. Feeding is to be conducted remotely.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0042 is a large bat‑like organism capable of draining blood at anomalous rates. Jaw musculature allows rapid puncture of reinforced materials. Ultrasonic emissions can induce nausea and disorientation.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Highly aggressive. Displays predatory pursuit behavior and attempts to latch onto moving targets.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0042-A: SCP-0042 drained a livestock carcass in under 30 seconds.
Addendum 0042-B: Ultrasonic emissions caused temporary vertigo in three guards.

pokemon_scp.name: Oddish
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0043 is to be kept in a botanical enclosure with nutrient‑rich soil. Personnel may interact with SCP-0043 under supervision.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0043 is a small plant‑based organism capable of nocturnal locomotion. Leaves emit faint bioluminescence and release harmless spores.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Docile and prefers darkness. Buries itself when frightened.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0043-A: SCP-0043 migrated 12 meters overnight despite no visible locomotion.
Addendum 0043-B: Leaf samples show anomalous chlorophyll density.

pokemon_scp.name: Gloom
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0044 is to be contained in a toxin‑filtered greenhouse. Personnel must wear respirators during interaction.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0044 emits a potent odor capable of inducing nausea, hallucinations, and temporary paralysis. Nectar secretions show psychoactive properties.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Slow-moving and lethargic. Odor intensity increases when SCP-0044 is distressed.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0044-A: Nectar exposure caused vivid hallucinations in a researcher.
Addendum 0044-B: Odor intensity reached hazardous levels during a containment alarm.

pokemon_scp.name: Vileplume
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0045 is to be contained in a hardened botanical dome with spore scrubbers and emergency hazmat protocols. No personnel may enter during bloom cycles.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0045’s flower releases toxic spores capable of causing respiratory failure. Petal impact generates shockwaves strong enough to fracture reinforced glass.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when threatened. Bloom cycles correlate with lunar phases.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0045-A: Spore release incapacitated an entire containment team.
Addendum 0045-B: Shockwave impact shattered a reinforced observation window.

pokemon_scp.name: Paras
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0046 is to be contained in a fungal‑controlled terrarium. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0046’s spores.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0046 is a small insectoid organism hosting parasitic fungi. Fungal growths exert partial control over SCP-0046’s behavior.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Displays erratic movement patterns. Fungal caps pulse rhythmically.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0046-A: Fungal spores attempted to colonize containment substrate.
Addendum 0046-B: SCP-0046 froze in place for 12 hours during a fungal pulse event.

pokemon_scp.name: Parasect
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0047 is to be contained in a hermetically sealed fungal vault with spore incineration systems. Personnel must not enter without full hazmat gear.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0047 is fully controlled by its parasitic fungus. The fungal cap produces spores capable of hijacking neural pathways in other organisms.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Moves slowly but deliberately. Attempts to approach living organisms for spore dispersal.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0047-A: Spore exposure caused temporary loss of motor control in a researcher.
Addendum 0047-B: Fungal cap expanded by 12% during a containment breach attempt.

pokemon_scp.name: Venonat
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0048 is to be contained in a low‑light chamber with toxin‑resistant surfaces. Personnel must avoid contact with SCP-0048’s fur.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0048’s fur secretes mild toxins and absorbs ambient light. Compound eyes emit infrared pulses used for navigation.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Skittish and avoids bright light. Shows curiosity toward heat sources.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0048-A: Infrared pulses disrupted thermal sensors.
Addendum 0048-B: Fur samples show anomalous toxin storage.

pokemon_scp.name: Venomoth
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0049 is to be contained in a toxin‑filtered aviary with UV‑shielded walls. Personnel must wear full hazmat gear.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0049’s wings release toxic dust capable of inducing paralysis, hallucinations, or respiratory failure. Dust particles show fractal patterns that shift under UV light.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Aggressive when disturbed. Uses dust clouds to incapacitate targets.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0049-A: Dust exposure caused severe hallucinations in three researchers.
Addendum 0049-B: Wing dust corroded containment sensors.

pokemon_scp.name: Diglett
pokemon_scp.special_containment_procedures: SCP-0050 is to be contained in a subterranean chamber with seismic sensors. Personnel must avoid standing directly above SCP-0050.
pokemon_scp.description: SCP-0050 is a burrowing organism that rarely reveals its full body. Capable of tunneling at anomalous speeds and generating minor tremors.
pokemon_scp.behavior_notes: Shy and avoids surface exposure. Emits low rumbling sounds when agitated.
addendum_logs: Addendum 0050-A: SCP-0050 tunneled through reinforced substrate in under 10 minutes.
Addendum 0050-B: Seismic rumbling correlated with nearby electromagnetic activity.
